description: Manually verified 30-question RAG accuracy benchmark grounded in the 10 baseline HVF/AVNL SOP PDFs.

questions.question: What is a hull?
questions.expected_answer: The armoured hull is the primary welded monocoque structural chassis and ballistic envelope housing crew, powerpack, and ammunition.

questions.question: What is a turret base ring?
questions.expected_answer: Precision-machined annular hull plinth interface ring mounting the cross-roller turret bearing raceway.

questions.question: What is a torsion bar?
questions.expected_answer: High-yield spring steel shaft acting as an elastic suspension spring anchored to the hull and connected to the road-wheel balancer arm.

questions.question: What does a ceramic-hybrid bearing do?
questions.expected_answer: Provides low-friction, high-stiffness rotational support for the turret azimuth assembly using Si3N4 ceramic roller elements.

questions.question: What is the function of a hydro-pneumatic recuperator?
questions.expected_answer: Pressurized nitrogen/hydraulic recuperator returns the 125mm gun barrel forward into battery position after firing recoil.

questions.question: What does the labyrinth seal do in the suspension housing?
questions.expected_answer: Seals the needle-bearing housing outer journal against mud, dust, and water ingress.

questions.question: How is the torsion bar connected to the balancer arm?
questions.expected_answer: The torsion bar splined head engages directly into mating internal splines of the road-wheel balancer arm.

questions.question: How is the turret base ring connected to the cross-roller bearing raceway?
questions.expected_answer: The turret base ring mounts the cross-roller bearing outer raceway with pre-tensioned fasteners after laser alignment.

questions.question: How does the drive sprocket interface with the track system?
questions.expected_answer: Drive sprocket teeth mesh directly with double-pin track link pins to drive the track assembly.

questions.question: What are the main assemblies and plates of the hull welding SOP?
questions.expected_answer: Identifies Hull Tub Assembly, Sponson Box, Glacis Plate, Lower Hull Plate, and Weld Joint Root Backing Strip.

questions.question: What are the main components of the turret mount system?
questions.expected_answer: Includes Turret Base Ring, Cross-Roller Bearing Raceway, Internal Ring Gear, Azimuth Pinion Drive, Ballistic Retention Ring, and Rotary Slip-Ring Assembly.

questions.question: What components make up the V12 powerpack assembly?
questions.expected_answer: Includes V12 Powerpack Engine, Crankshaft-to-Transmission Drive Shaft, Resilient Rubber-Metal/Hydromount Mounts, Dry-Sump Lubrication Loop, and Turbocharger Ducting.

questions.question: What are the preheat and interpass temperature limits in Hull Welding V1?
questions.expected_answer: 150°C minimum preheat and 220°C maximum interpass temperature (150-175°C soak preheat in Table 3.0).

questions.question: What is the hull volumetric datum envelope tolerance in Hull Welding V2?
questions.expected_answer: 6-DoF Laser Tracker Volumetric Envelope Tolerance is ≤ ±0.50 mm across 6.8 m span.

questions.question: What is the thermal shaft offset tolerance in Engine Alignment V2?
questions.expected_answer: Cold offset targets +0.10 mm vertical rise; running offset ≤ 0.035 mm.

questions.question: What is the recuperator nitrogen pre-charge pressure and artificial recoil stroke in Gun Calibration V1?
questions.expected_answer: Nitrogen pre-charge is 62.0 ± 0.5 bar with artificial recoil stroke 290-310 mm.

questions.question: What are the main steps in the engine alignment procedure?
questions.expected_answer: Inspect engine bay pedestals/hydromounts (Sec 1), hoist and lower V12 powerpack onto trunnions (Sec 2), execute dual-laser crankshaft-to-transmission alignment (Sec 3), connect fuel/lubrication/cooling lines and run dyno tests (Sec 4-6).

questions.question: How is the main gun barrel installed into the turret cradle and breech block?
questions.expected_answer: The gun tube is guided through the turret mantlet bronze/PTFE cradle bushes, rotated 45 degrees into the breech block interrupted buttress threads, locked with the tapered key, and balanced on the trunnion axis.

questions.question: What surface cleaning and pre-fitup checks are performed on RHA plates before hull welding?
questions.expected_answer: Spectrographic CEV audit, Brinell hardness mapping, double-V bevel check, carbide HAZ dress, and white-cloth acetone wipe test for moisture and oxide clearance.

questions.question: What changed between V1 and V2 of the turret integration SOP?
questions.expected_answer: Plinth flatness tightened from ≤ 0.05 mm to ≤ 0.035 mm; backlash tightened from 0.18-0.26 mm to 0.14-0.20 mm; breakaway torque lowered from ≤ 420 Nm to ≤ 380 Nm; chrome-molybdenum bearing upgraded to Si3N4 ceramic-hybrid bearing; electrical slip-ring upgraded to fibre-optic rotary joint (FORJ).

questions.question: What changed in Hull Welding between V1 (Rev 4.2) and V2 (Rev 5.0)?
questions.expected_answer: Base material hardness shifted from 380-440 BHN to 420-460 BHN; preheat/interpass tightened from 150°C/220°C to 160°C/210°C; datum envelope tightened from ±0.80 mm to ±0.50 mm; ambient stabilization extended from 48 hours to 72 hours.

questions.question: How did Torsion Suspension tolerances change from V1 (Rev 4.0) to V2 (Rev 5.2)?
questions.expected_answer: Ground/belly clearance precision changed from 450 mm ± 6 mm to 455 mm ± 4 mm; track catenary sag tightened from 32-38 mm (manual) to 35 mm ± 2 mm (automated hydraulic tensioner); road-wheel seals upgraded to triple-lip PTFE cassette seals.

questions.question: How do hull welding datum tolerances affect turret integration?
questions.expected_answer: Hull envelope and upper deck flatness/plinth boring directly govern turret base ring co-planarity (≤ 0.035 mm TIR V2) and azimuth bearing mounting.

questions.question: How does main gun trunnion alignment relate to turret integration and optical slip-rings?
questions.expected_answer: Gun barrel trunnion mounting and Muzzle Reference System / Fire Control optical harmonization rely on stabilized turret traverse drives and the rotary fibre-optic/electrical slip-ring assembly.

questions.question: What are the ceramic-hybrid bearing specifications in V1 Turret Integration?
questions.expected_answer: The selected V1 revision does not specify ceramic-hybrid bearings (V1 uses chrome-molybdenum bearing elements; ceramic-hybrid bearings were introduced in V2).

questions.question: What are the active hydromount tuning curves in Engine Alignment V1?
questions.expected_answer: V1 uses resilient rubber-metal mounts; dynamic ±2.0% hydromount tuning was introduced in V2 and is not documented in V1.

questions.question: What coupled thermal/pressure tolerance links engine bay bilge scavenge blowers to the hermetic turret NBC seal?
questions.expected_answer: The SOP corpus does not provide specific coupled thermal or pressure tolerances linking engine bay bilge scavenge flow to turret NBC sealing.

questions.question: What is the radio frequency encryption key algorithm used in battle management communications?
questions.expected_answer: Abstains because radio encryption algorithms are not covered in the 10 tank manufacturing SOPs.

questions.question: What is the radar cross-section signature target for stealth aircraft coatings?
questions.expected_answer: Abstains because aircraft stealth coatings are outside the scope of HVF armoured vehicle manufacturing SOPs.

questions.question: What is the submarine sonar array calibration depth in meters?
questions.expected_answer: Abstains because naval submarine sonar calibration is absent from the HVF MBT SOP corpus.
